channel_first_1x1Conv_static_assessment.algebra: Linear(x)=x W.T+b equals Conv2d(permute(x), W[:,:,None,None], b) for independently mapped D/M positions
channel_first_1x1Conv_static_assessment.same_parameters_possible: functional convolution may view the original 2D parameter tensors as 4D; module/state alias coverage must still be independently verified
axes: predecessor/successor along D(axis2), keep boundary c1/c2 bias
LayerNorm must remain normalization across C, not InstanceNorm or spatial normalization
risks: Channel-only LayerNorm on NCHW needs exact mean/variance across C or permutes; recurrent GRU branches and reductions must retain semantics.
RKNN inserts layout transposes independently of ONNX Transpose count; replacing Linear alone does not prove removal.
One source block without all-channel layout conversion may shift pack/transpose cost to boundaries.
Convolution compilation can change accumulation, precision and fusion; fixed output gate remains mandatory.
